name: Calibrated noise, ST/T preservation and independent analyzer abstention
calibration: One scalar across I,II,V1-V6 from aggregate centered RMS on [4,14)s. Noise starts as arbitrary digital counts (header gain=0); calibration converts its mixtures to mV. This is NOT the QRS-weighted nst program SNR and not 12 independently recorded electrode noises. Derived limb leads are rebuilt algebraically.
filterPolicy: Imported highpass/biquad kernels at 500 Hz on the full 14 s, then crop 4 s. Nominal highpass 0.05/0.5/2 Hz and lowpass 40 Hz in monitor/aggressive; no notch. This offline post-acquisition stress chain is NOT identical to the native 1000 Hz pre-decimation chain. A separate native clean comparison exercises synthesize filters directly.
referencePolicy: Clean sampled morphology with fixed generator event windows, never measure(clean) as truth. Analyzer gets fs/leads only. QRS midpoint is an event association anchor (150 ms tolerance), not a clinical R fiducial. Programmed widths/QT are synthetic reference, not human delineation.
thresholdPolicy: Engineering review flags chosen before external execution, not validated clinical acceptance thresholds. External performance is reported without tuning/omitting failures. CI fails on integrity/contracts, not on demanding an unproven clinical success rate.
